# OTel Metric Exporter v0.4.4 - Table of Contents

An unofficial OTel-compatible metric exporter

## Modules

- [OtelMetricExporter](https://otel-metric-exporter.hexdocs.pm/OtelMetricExporter.md): This is a `telemetry` exporter that collects specified metrics
and then exports them to an OTel endpoint. It uses metric definitions
from `:telemetry_metrics` library.
- [OtelMetricExporter.Application](https://otel-metric-exporter.hexdocs.pm/OtelMetricExporter.Application.md)
- [OtelMetricExporter.LogHandler](https://otel-metric-exporter.hexdocs.pm/OtelMetricExporter.LogHandler.md): A Logger handler that forwards log events to OTel collector via OTLP protocol.
- [OtelMetricExporter.OtelApi.Config](https://otel-metric-exporter.hexdocs.pm/OtelMetricExporter.OtelApi.Config.md)
- [OtelMetricExporter.TelemetryHandlers](https://otel-metric-exporter.hexdocs.pm/OtelMetricExporter.TelemetryHandlers.md)
